goal: Publish a truthful event slider that continues beyond three verified offers.
authorization: Implementation, testing, commit, push and public publication are authorized for this correction.

requirements.statement: The event rail exposes more than three real published venues and allows bounded continuation up to 20 cards.
evidence: Candidate composes verified offers first and fills the remaining rail from the published event catalog up to 20.

requirements.statement: Only supplier-confirmed offers display availability, date, slot and price.
evidence: Browse-only cards carry an explicit availability-check label and no verified-offer fields.

requirements.statement: The whole card opens the venue while phone and WhatsApp remain independent actions.
evidence: The redundant details button was removed and PlacePreviewCard contact behavior was preserved.

requirements.statement: Homepage, events landing and regional event rails remain responsive and consistent.
evidence: Shared EventLastMinute implementation changed once for all three surfaces.
Desktop and 390px candidate checks each rendered 20 cards, one enabled continuation control, no page overflow and no hydration error.
Production build and all 1,416 repository tests passed.

requirements.statement: The exact tested candidate is public and verified on desktop and 390px mobile with a rollback identity.
